## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 is in draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 (open), on branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2`. The grid supports drag and resize with react-grid-layout. Layout is saved per user through `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, with a localStorage fallback, and everything sits behind `dashboards_v2`. Widget sizing uses a ResizeObserver hook because container queries don't work on iOS 15 Safari. `DashboardTile` is renamed to `WidgetCard`, with a deprecated re-export for the v1 list. Lint, typecheck and the Storybook build pass.

- [en-cours] Priya's UX review of the iPad behaviour, which is still pending
- [prochaine-étape] Priya reviews the UX on iPad (BrowserStack, iOS 15.7) before the Zest demo on Tuesday 24th
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only, in the flags admin
- [essai-raté] Container queries: iOS 15 Safari ignores `@container` rules without any error, so they were removed
- [décision] Size widgets with a ResizeObserver hook and drop container queries, to keep a single system (source: t09)
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards behind the flag until January and remove nothing (source: t15)
- [décision] Open the PR as a draft for Priya's UX review (source: t17)
- [décision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard` everywhere (source: t11)
